question:
In the following figure, if PQ || RS, then find the value of ∠ABC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78c49893c30dec0edaf41ec37611f52d8f6c5ac4989a9d5dde841247f9ebbc21.png]
solution:
Calculation :-

we construct a line XY passing through the point B and parallel to the line PQ and RS.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d515a037d64db6a3eb0913dae5d557ffad02d3256fe577382b83a195eab5ad2.png] 

∠ QAB = ∠ ABX [ Alternate angle ]

⇒ ∠ ABX = 50° 

∠YBC = ∠BCR [ Alternate angle ]

⇒ ∠YBC = 120° 

∠XBC + ∠YBC = 180° [ supplementary angle ]

∠XBC = 180° - 120° = 60° 

Now,

∠B = ∠XBC + ∠ ABX 

 60° + 50° = 110°
